items.headline: U.S. Stocks Close Mixed Amid Inflation Concerns; Tech Outperforms
items.summary: U.S. equities closed a volatile Friday session mixed, as elevated Treasury yields and persistent oil prices above $100 per barrel fueled inflation concerns and increased expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes. While the Nasdaq Composite managed to climb, the S&P 500 was largely flat, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average extended its weekly losses. Underlying market breadth remained weak despite index resilience, with significant sector rotation observed as technology stocks, particularly AI-adjacent chips and crypto-related assets, rallied against declines in energy and financial sectors.

items.headline: Coinbase Surges on Crypto Tailwinds
items.summary: Coinbase Global ($COIN) jumped 11.7% today, benefiting from a broader 'risk-on' sentiment in cryptocurrency markets which saw Bitcoin climb past $81,000 and Solana surge 11% over the past 24 hours.

items.headline: Alibaba Posts Strong Daily Gain
items.summary: Alibaba ($BABA) saw a notable increase, rising 4.36% to $113.26 by the end of the session.

items.headline: Netflix Drops on Continued Woes
items.summary: Netflix ($NFLX) fell 4.7% to $71.79, extending its monthly slide amid concerns over market saturation, password-sharing crackdowns, and rising content costs.

items.headline: Qualcomm Slides Amid Broader Tech Weakness
items.summary: Qualcomm ($QCOM) experienced a significant drop, falling 5.8% today.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Jump, Mortgage Rates Follow After Fed Rate Hike
items.summary: The 2-year Treasury yield surged to a two-year high of 4.74% on Friday, with the 10-year yield closing at 5.01%, as traders priced in further Federal Reserve rate hikes following this week's quarter-percentage-point increase. This hawkish sentiment pushed the 30-year fixed mortgage rate to 6.95%, up 19 basis points in a single week.

items.headline: Energy and Financials Lag as AI-Adjacent Chips Rally
items.summary: Sector rotation was pronounced today, with energy stocks declining 5-6% and financials dropping 3-4%, partly due to a 5.7% fall in Brent crude prices. Conversely, Coinbase and a selection of AI-adjacent semiconductor stocks, including ARM, Micron, ASML, and Broadcom, saw strong bids, reflecting sustained investor interest in the technology sector.

items.headline: SpaceX's Nasdaq 100 Weight Set to Increase Significantly
items.summary: SpaceX is poised for a substantial increase in its Nasdaq 100 Index weight, rising to 2.82% from approximately 1.28% based on Friday's closing prices. This adjustment reflects the company's escalating market capitalization, now exceeding $2 trillion, and is expected to lead to asset reallocation in passive funds tracking the index.

items.headline: XCHG Limited Reports Wider First-Half Loss
items.summary: XCHG Limited ($XCH) reported its H1 2026 earnings, posting lower revenue and higher operating costs, which resulted in a wider loss for the first half of the year. The company stated it is targeting stronger second-half growth.
